candidates.objective: Improve context candidate recall without weakening deterministic admission controls.
candidates.proposed_action: Add a bounded candidate-retrieval stage that may propose additional relevant receipt items, then require the existing Context Compiler to apply freshness, relation, budget, provenance, and authority-neutral admission controls.

candidates.objective: Expose retained execution evidence in the Graph Engineering OS operator view without making the UI a new source of truth.
candidates.proposed_action: Add a read-only adapter that renders canonical Leverage Engine receipts, context packages, routing decisions, and improvement analyses in Graph Engineering OS.

candidates.objective: Reduce repository tracking noise and duplicate control records.
candidates.proposed_action: Add an idempotent canonical-directive lookup before creating tracking records and require one bounded directive issue to remain the source of truth for each increment.

candidates.objective: Keep executor performance history stable across incidental validation and observability tooling changes.
candidates.proposed_action: Add an explicit capability_toolset field for routing identity while retaining the complete tools list as execution telemetry.

not_in_scope: lowering evidence thresholds solely to force a route
candidates.objective: Increase comparable execution evidence without lowering routing confidence thresholds.
candidates.proposed_action: Standardize receipt capture for repeated comparable repository tasks so routing profiles accumulate enough real samples to leave REVIEW honestly.
